title: Barber's team brought in for DoD; 59+ agencies not coordinating at Picatinny

tellings.quote: There were over 59 local law enforcement entities working not coordinating there. We had FBI, we had DoD, we had private partners

plain: A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he once retrieved a UFO, says that in 2024 his team was brought in for the Department of Defense at Picatinny Arsenal, an Army base in New Jersey. He says more than 59 local police bodies were working there without coordinating, along with the FBI, the Department of Defense and private partners. Barber tells it as someone who took part, and it would mean the response to events there was large and disorganized.
